3 /-! All twenty-eight subdivision triangle pairs are separated for every selected development. -/
4 
5 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.SixVertexGraph.Development
6 
7 open OctahedralTriangles OctahedralNet
8 
9 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {graph : P.SixVertexGraph}
10 variable {small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
11   (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4} {source : Fin 6} {slit : Fin 4}
12 variable (net : graph.Development small_faces source slit)
13 
14 theorem mixed_of_remainingNine (remaining : net.RemainingNine) (i j : Fin 4) (different : i ≠ j) :
15     net.Separated (false, i) (true, j) := by
16   fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
17   · exact False.elim (different rfl)
18   · exact net.neighboring_fan_petal 0
19   · exact (remaining.remote 2).symm
20   · exact remaining.slit_right.symm
21   · exact (net.neighboring_petal_fan 0).symm
22   · exact False.elim (different rfl)
23   · exact net.neighboring_fan_petal 1
24   · exact (remaining.remote 3).symm
25   · exact (remaining.remote 0).symm
26   · exact (net.neighboring_petal_fan 1).symm
27   · exact False.elim (different rfl)
28   · exact net.neighboring_fan_petal 2
29   · exact remaining.slit_left.symm
30   · exact (remaining.remote 1).symm
31   · exact (net.neighboring_petal_fan 2).symm
32   · exact False.elim (different rfl)
33 
34 theorem petals_of_remainingNine (remaining : net.RemainingNine) (i j : Fin 4) (different : i ≠ j) :
35     net.Separated (true, i) (true, j) := by
36   fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
37   · exact False.elim (different rfl)
38   · exact net.neighboring_petals 0
39   · exact remaining.opposite_even
40   · exact remaining.slit_petals
41   · exact (net.neighboring_petals 0).symm
42   · exact False.elim (different rfl)
43   · exact net.neighboring_petals 1
44   · exact remaining.opposite_odd
45   · exact remaining.opposite_even.symm
46   · exact (net.neighboring_petals 1).symm
47   · exact False.elim (different rfl)
48   · exact net.neighboring_petals 2
49   · exact remaining.slit_petals.symm
50   · exact remaining.opposite_odd.symm
51   · exact (net.neighboring_petals 2).symm
52   · exact False.elim (different rfl)

54 /-- This result concerns the eight actual triangles, including subdivisions of quadrilateral facets. -/
55 theorem selected_triangles_nonoverlap
56     (source_order : graph.curvature (opposite source) ≤ graph.curvature source)
57     (maximal : ∀ i, graph.curvature (fanNeighbor source i) ≤ graph.curvature (fanNeighbor source slit)) :
58     ∀ x y : FaceIndex, x ≠ y → net.Separated x y := by
59   have remaining := net.remainingNine_of_core (net.selected_local_pairs source_order maximal)
60     (net.selected_opposite_petals source_order maximal) (net.selected_finite_cuts_clear source_order maximal)
61   rintro ⟨left, i⟩ ⟨right, j⟩ different
62   cases left <;> cases right
63   · exact net.fan.nonoverlap i j (fun same => different (Prod.ext rfl same))
64   · by_cases same : i = j
65     · subst j
66       exact net.attached_pair_nonoverlap i
67     · exact net.mixed_of_remainingNine remaining i j same
68   · by_cases same : j = i
69     · subst j
70       exact (net.attached_pair_nonoverlap i).symm
71     · exact (net.mixed_of_remainingNine remaining j i same).symm
72   · exact net.petals_of_remainingNine remaining i j (fun same => different (Prod.ext rfl same))
73 
74 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.SixVertexGraph.Development
